metadata.title: CMMI for Development (CMMI-DEV) v1.3 — Level 3 Practice Catalog
metadata.source: CMMI for Development, Version 1.3, CMU/SEI-2010-TR-033, Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute
metadata.description: Capability Maturity Model Integration for Development (CMMI-DEV) Level 3 practice catalog. Level 3 (Defined) includes all Level 2 (Managed) process areas plus the Level 3 process areas. Processes are well characterized, understood, and described in standards, procedures, tools, and methods. Each specific practice maps to NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls via crosswalk.

2.name: Managed
2.description: Projects are planned, performed, measured, and controlled at the project level.

3.name: Defined
3.description: Processes are well characterized and understood, described in standards, procedures, tools, and methods.

process_areas.name: Configuration Management
process_areas.purpose: Establish and maintain the integrity of work products using configuration identification, configuration control, configuration status accounting, and configuration audits.

process_areas.name: Measurement and Analysis
process_areas.purpose: Develop and sustain a measurement capability used to support management information needs.

process_areas.name: Project Monitoring and Control
process_areas.purpose: Provide an understanding of the project's progress so that appropriate corrective actions can be taken when the project's performance deviates significantly from the plan.

process_areas.name: Project Planning
process_areas.purpose: Establish and maintain plans that define project activities.

process_areas.name: Process and Product Quality Assurance
process_areas.purpose: Provide staff and management with objective insight into processes and associated work products.

process_areas.name: Requirements Management
process_areas.purpose: Manage the requirements of the project's products and product components and identify inconsistencies between those requirements and the project's plans and work products.

process_areas.name: Supplier Agreement Management
process_areas.purpose: Manage the acquisition of products and services from suppliers.

process_areas.name: Decision Analysis and Resolution
process_areas.purpose: Analyze possible decisions using a formal evaluation process that evaluates identified alternatives against established criteria.

process_areas.name: Integrated Project Management
process_areas.purpose: Establish and manage the project and the involvement of the relevant stakeholders according to an integrated and defined process.

process_areas.name: Organizational Process Definition
process_areas.purpose: Establish and maintain a usable set of organizational process assets and work environment standards.

process_areas.name: Organizational Process Focus
process_areas.purpose: Plan, implement, and deploy organizational process improvements based on a thorough understanding of the current strengths and weaknesses of the organization's processes and process assets.

process_areas.name: Organizational Training
process_areas.purpose: Develop the skills and knowledge of people so they can perform their roles effectively and efficiently.

process_areas.name: Product Integration
process_areas.purpose: Assemble the product from the product components, ensure that the product, as integrated, functions properly, and deliver the product.

process_areas.name: Requirements Development
process_areas.purpose: Produce and analyze customer, product, and product component requirements.

process_areas.name: Risk Management
process_areas.purpose: Identify potential problems before they occur so that risk-handling activities can be planned and invoked as needed across the life of the product to mitigate adverse impacts on achieving objectives.

process_areas.name: Technical Solution
process_areas.purpose: Design, develop, and implement solutions to requirements. Solutions, designs, and implementations encompass products, product components, and product-related lifecycle processes either singly or in combination.

process_areas.name: Validation
process_areas.purpose: Demonstrate that a product or product component fulfills its intended use when placed in its intended environment.

process_areas.name: Verification
process_areas.purpose: Ensure that selected work products meet their specified requirements.

requirements.title: Identify Configuration Items
requirements.description: Identify the configuration items, components, and related work products that will be placed under configuration management.
requirements.evidence_required: Configuration item list, CM plan, work product inventory.

requirements.title: Establish a Configuration Management System
requirements.description: Establish and maintain a configuration management and change management system for controlling work products.
requirements.evidence_required: CM system documentation, version control repository, access controls.

requirements.title: Create or Release Baselines
requirements.description: Create or release baselines for internal use and for delivery to the customer.
requirements.evidence_required: Baseline records, release documentation, CM audit trail.

requirements.title: Track Change Requests
requirements.description: Track change requests for the configuration items.
requirements.evidence_required: Change request log, change tracking system, approval records.

requirements.title: Control Configuration Items
requirements.description: Control changes to the configuration items.
requirements.evidence_required: Access controls, change approval records, configuration control board minutes.

requirements.title: Establish Configuration Management Records
requirements.description: Establish and maintain records describing configuration items.
requirements.evidence_required: Configuration status accounting records, CM database.

requirements.title: Perform Configuration Audits
requirements.description: Perform configuration audits to maintain the integrity of the configuration baselines.
requirements.evidence_required: Configuration audit reports, discrepancy resolution records.

requirements.title: Establish Measurement Objectives
requirements.description: Establish and maintain measurement objectives that are derived from identified information needs and objectives.
requirements.evidence_required: Measurement objectives documentation, information needs analysis.

requirements.title: Specify Measures
requirements.description: Specify measures to address the measurement objectives.
requirements.evidence_required: Measure specifications, measurement definitions.

requirements.title: Collect Measurement Data
requirements.description: Obtain specified measurement data.
requirements.evidence_required: Data collection procedures, measurement data repository.

requirements.title: Analyze Measurement Data
requirements.description: Analyze and interpret measurement data.
requirements.evidence_required: Analysis reports, trend data, measurement results.

requirements.title: Communicate Results
requirements.description: Communicate results of measurement and analysis activities to all relevant stakeholders.
requirements.evidence_required: Measurement reports, stakeholder communication records.

requirements.title: Monitor Project Planning Parameters
requirements.description: Monitor actual values of project planning parameters against the project plan.
requirements.evidence_required: Status reports, earned value data, schedule tracking records.

requirements.title: Monitor Project Risks
requirements.description: Monitor risks against those identified in the project plan.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk tracking records, risk status reports.

requirements.title: Conduct Progress Reviews
requirements.description: Periodically review the project's progress, performance, and issues.
requirements.evidence_required: Progress review meeting minutes, status reports.

requirements.title: Analyze Issues
requirements.description: Collect and analyze the issues and determine the corrective actions necessary to address them.
requirements.evidence_required: Issue tracking records, root cause analysis documentation.

requirements.title: Take Corrective Action
requirements.description: Take corrective action on identified issues.
requirements.evidence_required: Corrective action records, plan revision history.

requirements.title: Estimate the Scope of the Project
requirements.description: Establish a top-level work breakdown structure (WBS) to estimate the scope of the project.
requirements.evidence_required: Work breakdown structure, scope documentation.

requirements.title: Estimate Effort and Cost
requirements.description: Estimate the project effort and cost for the work products and tasks based on estimation rationale.
requirements.evidence_required: Estimation models, historical data, cost and schedule estimates.

requirements.title: Establish the Budget and Schedule
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the project's budget and schedule.
requirements.evidence_required: Project schedule, budget documentation, milestone list.

requirements.title: Identify Project Risks
requirements.description: Identify and analyze project risks.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk register, risk analysis documentation.

requirements.title: Plan Needed Knowledge and Skills
requirements.description: Plan for knowledge and skills needed to perform the project.
requirements.evidence_required: Skills matrix, training plan, staffing plan.

requirements.title: Obtain Plan Commitment
requirements.description: Obtain commitment from relevant stakeholders responsible for performing and supporting plan execution.
requirements.evidence_required: Signed-off project plan, stakeholder commitment records.

requirements.title: Objectively Evaluate Processes
requirements.description: Objectively evaluate the designated performed processes against the applicable process descriptions, standards, and procedures.
requirements.evidence_required: QA evaluation records, process audit reports.

requirements.title: Objectively Evaluate Work Products
requirements.description: Objectively evaluate the designated work products against the applicable process descriptions, standards, and procedures.
requirements.evidence_required: Work product audit reports, QA checklists.

requirements.title: Communicate and Ensure Resolution of Noncompliances
requirements.description: Communicate quality issues and ensure the resolution of noncompliance issues with the staff and managers.
requirements.evidence_required: Noncompliance issue tracking, escalation records.

requirements.title: Establish Records
requirements.description: Establish and maintain records of the quality assurance activities.
requirements.evidence_required: QA activity logs, evaluation records.

requirements.title: Obtain Understanding of Requirements
requirements.description: Develop an understanding of the requirements with the requirements providers.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements review records, clarification log.

requirements.title: Obtain Commitment to Requirements
requirements.description: Obtain commitment from project participants on the requirements.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements sign-off records, stakeholder approval.

requirements.title: Manage Requirements Changes
requirements.description: Manage changes to the requirements as they evolve during the project.
requirements.evidence_required: Change control records, requirements change log, impact analysis.

requirements.title: Maintain Bidirectional Traceability of Requirements
requirements.description: Maintain bidirectional traceability among the requirements and the project plans and work products.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements traceability matrix, traceability tool outputs.

requirements.title: Identify Inconsistencies Between Project Work and Requirements
requirements.description: Identify inconsistencies between the project plans and work products and the requirements.
requirements.evidence_required: Inconsistency reports, corrective action records.

requirements.title: Determine Acquisition Type
requirements.description: Determine the type of acquisition for each product or product component to be acquired.
requirements.evidence_required: Acquisition strategy documentation, make-or-buy analysis.

requirements.title: Establish Supplier Agreements
requirements.description: Establish and maintain formal agreements with the supplier.
requirements.evidence_required: Contracts, SOWs, MOUs, supplier agreements.

requirements.title: Execute the Supplier Agreement
requirements.description: Perform the activities with the supplier as specified in the supplier agreement.
requirements.evidence_required: Supplier performance records, deliverable acceptance.

requirements.title: Evaluate Selected Supplier Work Products
requirements.description: Select, monitor, and analyze the processes used by the supplier.
requirements.evidence_required: Supplier audit reports, work product evaluation records.

requirements.title: Accept the Acquired Product
requirements.description: Ensure that the supplier agreement is satisfied before accepting the acquired product.
requirements.evidence_required: Acceptance testing records, product acceptance documentation.

requirements.title: Establish Guidelines for Decision Analysis
requirements.description: Establish and maintain guidelines to determine which issues are subject to a formal evaluation process.
requirements.evidence_required: DAR guidelines, decision criteria thresholds, policy documentation.

requirements.title: Establish Evaluation Criteria
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the criteria for evaluating alternatives and the relative ranking of these criteria.
requirements.evidence_required: Evaluation criteria documentation, weighting rationale.

requirements.title: Identify Alternative Solutions
requirements.description: Identify alternative solutions to address the issue under analysis.
requirements.evidence_required: Alternatives analysis documentation, solution options list.

requirements.title: Evaluate Alternatives
requirements.description: Evaluate alternative solutions using the established criteria and methods.
requirements.evidence_required: Evaluation results, trade study reports, scoring matrices.

requirements.title: Select Solutions
requirements.description: Select solutions from the alternatives based on the evaluation criteria.
requirements.evidence_required: Decision rationale, selection documentation, approval records.

requirements.title: Establish the Project's Defined Process
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the project's defined process from project startup through the life of the project.
requirements.evidence_required: Project-defined process documentation, tailoring records.

requirements.title: Use Organizational Process Assets for Planning
requirements.description: Use the organizational process assets and the measurement repository for estimating and planning the project's activities.
requirements.evidence_required: Process asset usage records, estimation data from repository.

requirements.title: Integrate Plans
requirements.description: Integrate the project plan and the other plans that affect the project to describe the project's defined process.
requirements.evidence_required: Integrated project plan, cross-plan consistency records.

requirements.title: Manage the Project Using the Integrated Plans
requirements.description: Manage the project using the project plan, the other plans that affect the project, and the project's defined process.
requirements.evidence_required: Project management records, status reports, deviation handling.

requirements.title: Contribute to the Organizational Process Assets
requirements.description: Contribute work products, measures, measurement results, and documented experiences to the organizational process assets.
requirements.evidence_required: Lessons learned records, process asset contributions.

requirements.title: Establish Standard Processes
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the organization's set of standard processes.
requirements.evidence_required: Standard process library, process documentation.

requirements.title: Establish Lifecycle Model Descriptions
requirements.description: Establish and maintain descriptions of the lifecycle models approved for use in the organization.
requirements.evidence_required: Lifecycle model documentation, approved SDLC documentation.

requirements.title: Establish Tailoring Criteria and Guidelines
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the tailoring criteria and guidelines for the organization's set of standard processes.
requirements.evidence_required: Tailoring guidelines, process tailoring procedures.

requirements.title: Establish the Organization's Measurement Repository
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the organization's measurement repository.
requirements.evidence_required: Measurement repository, data collection procedures.

requirements.title: Establish the Organization's Process Asset Library
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the organization's process asset library.
requirements.evidence_required: Process asset library contents, maintenance records.

requirements.title: Establish Work Environment Standards
requirements.description: Establish and maintain work environment standards.
requirements.evidence_required: Work environment standards documentation, tooling standards.

requirements.title: Establish Organizational Process Needs
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the description of the process needs and objectives for the organization.
requirements.evidence_required: Process needs analysis, organizational objectives documentation.

requirements.title: Appraise the Organization's Processes
requirements.description: Appraise the processes of the organization periodically and as needed to maintain an understanding of their strengths and weaknesses.
requirements.evidence_required: CMMI appraisal records, SCAMPI results, process assessment reports.

requirements.title: Identify the Organization's Process Improvements
requirements.description: Identify improvements to the organization's processes and process assets.
requirements.evidence_required: Process improvement backlog, gap analysis reports.

requirements.title: Establish Process Action Plans
requirements.description: Establish and maintain process action plans to address improvements to the organization's processes and process assets.
requirements.evidence_required: Process action plans, improvement roadmap.

requirements.title: Implement Process Action Plans
requirements.description: Implement process action plans.
requirements.evidence_required: Implementation records, process improvement evidence.

requirements.title: Monitor Implementation
requirements.description: Monitor the implementation of the process action plans.
requirements.evidence_required: Implementation monitoring reports, milestone tracking.

requirements.title: Establish the Strategic Training Needs
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the strategic training needs of the organization.
requirements.evidence_required: Training needs analysis, strategic training plan.

requirements.title: Establish an Organizational Training Tactical Plan
requirements.description: Establish and maintain an organizational training tactical plan.
requirements.evidence_required: Training tactical plan, training schedule.

requirements.title: Establish Training Capability
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the training capability to address organizational training needs.
requirements.evidence_required: Training materials, instructor qualifications, training tools.

requirements.title: Deliver Training
requirements.description: Deliver the designated training following the organizational training tactical plan.
requirements.evidence_required: Training completion records, attendance rosters.

requirements.title: Establish Training Records
requirements.description: Establish and maintain records of the organizational training.
requirements.evidence_required: Training records, completion certificates, training database.

requirements.title: Assess Training Effectiveness
requirements.description: Assess the effectiveness of the organization's training program.
requirements.evidence_required: Training evaluation surveys, effectiveness metrics.

requirements.title: Determine Integration Sequence
requirements.description: Determine the product component integration sequence.
requirements.evidence_required: Integration sequence plan, integration strategy document.

requirements.title: Establish the Product Integration Environment
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the environment needed to support the integration of the product components.
requirements.evidence_required: Integration environment documentation, environment configuration records.

requirements.title: Review Interface Descriptions for Completeness
requirements.description: Review interface descriptions for coverage and completeness.
requirements.evidence_required: Interface control documents (ICDs), interface review records.

requirements.title: Confirm Readiness of Product Components for Integration
requirements.description: Confirm, prior to assembling the product components, that each product component required to assemble the product has been properly identified, functions according to its description, and that the interfaces comply with the interface descriptions.
requirements.evidence_required: Component readiness checklist, pre-integration test results.

requirements.title: Assemble Product Components
requirements.description: Assemble the product components according to the product integration sequence and available procedures.
requirements.evidence_required: Build records, assembly procedures, integration test results.

requirements.title: Elicit Needs
requirements.description: Elicit stakeholder needs, expectations, constraints, and interfaces for all phases of the product lifecycle.
requirements.evidence_required: Stakeholder interviews, focus group notes, needs documentation.

requirements.title: Develop the Customer Requirements
requirements.description: Transform stakeholder needs, expectations, constraints, and interfaces into customer requirements.
requirements.evidence_required: Customer requirements document, ConOps, use cases.

requirements.title: Establish Product and Product Component Requirements
requirements.description: Establish and maintain product and product component requirements.
requirements.evidence_required: System requirements specification (SRS), product requirements document.

requirements.title: Allocate Product Component Requirements
requirements.description: Allocate the requirements for each product component.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements allocation matrix, interface specifications.

requirements.title: Analyze Requirements
requirements.description: Analyze requirements to ensure that they are necessary and sufficient.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements analysis reports, completeness/consistency review records.

requirements.title: Validate Requirements
requirements.description: Validate requirements to ensure that the resulting product will perform as intended in the user's environment.
requirements.evidence_required: Requirements validation records, prototype evaluation, simulation results.

requirements.title: Determine Risk Sources and Categories
requirements.description: Determine risk sources and categories.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk taxonomy, risk source catalog, risk category definitions.

requirements.title: Define Risk Parameters
requirements.description: Define the parameters used to analyze and categorize risks and the parameters used to control the risk management effort.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk likelihood and impact scales, risk thresholds, risk management policy.

requirements.title: Establish a Risk Management Strategy
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the strategy to be used for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating risks.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk management plan, risk management strategy document.

requirements.title: Identify and Analyze Risks
requirements.description: Identify and analyze risks to determine their importance.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk register, risk analysis documentation, risk prioritization.

requirements.title: Develop Risk Mitigation Plans
requirements.description: Develop a risk mitigation plan in accordance with the risk management strategy.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk mitigation plans, contingency plans.

requirements.title: Implement Risk Mitigation Plans
requirements.description: Monitor the status of each risk periodically and implement the risk mitigation plan as appropriate.
requirements.evidence_required: Risk status tracking, mitigation action records, risk closure documentation.

requirements.title: Select Product Component Solutions
requirements.description: Select the product component solutions from alternative solutions.
requirements.evidence_required: Solution selection documentation, trade study results, DAR records.

requirements.title: Develop the Design
requirements.description: Develop a design for the product or product component.
requirements.evidence_required: Architecture design documentation, design artifacts, design reviews.

requirements.title: Design Interfaces Using Criteria
requirements.description: Design product component interfaces using established criteria.
requirements.evidence_required: Interface design specification, interface control documents.

requirements.title: Implement the Design
requirements.description: Implement the designs of the product components.
requirements.evidence_required: Implemented code/components, build artifacts.

requirements.title: Develop Product Support Documentation
requirements.description: Develop and maintain end-use documentation.
requirements.evidence_required: User manuals, operations guides, technical documentation.

requirements.title: Select Products for Validation
requirements.description: Select products and product components to be validated and the validation methods that will be used.
requirements.evidence_required: Validation selection records, validation approach documentation.

requirements.title: Establish the Validation Environment
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the environment needed to support validation.
requirements.evidence_required: Validation environment configuration, test environment records.

requirements.title: Establish Validation Procedures and Criteria
requirements.description: Establish and maintain procedures and criteria for validation.
requirements.evidence_required: Validation test plans, acceptance criteria, validation procedures.

requirements.title: Perform Validation
requirements.description: Perform validation on the selected products and product components.
requirements.evidence_required: Validation test results, validation reports, acceptance records.

requirements.title: Select Work Products for Verification
requirements.description: Select the work products to be verified and the verification methods that will be used.
requirements.evidence_required: Verification selection records, verification approach.

requirements.title: Establish the Verification Environment
requirements.description: Establish and maintain the environment needed to support verification.
requirements.evidence_required: Verification environment documentation, tool configurations.

requirements.title: Establish Verification Procedures and Criteria
requirements.description: Establish and maintain verification procedures and criteria for the selected work products.
requirements.evidence_required: Verification procedures, acceptance criteria, test plans.

requirements.title: Prepare for Peer Reviews
requirements.description: Prepare for peer reviews of the selected work products.
requirements.evidence_required: Peer review schedule, reviewer assignments, review materials.

requirements.title: Conduct Peer Reviews
requirements.description: Conduct peer reviews on the selected work products and identify issues resulting from the peer reviews.
requirements.evidence_required: Peer review records, defect logs, review meeting minutes.

requirements.title: Analyze Peer Review Data
requirements.description: Analyze data about preparation, conduct, and results of the peer reviews.
requirements.evidence_required: Peer review metrics, defect trend data, process improvement inputs.

requirements.title: Perform Verification
requirements.description: Perform verification on the selected work products.
requirements.evidence_required: Verification test results, verification reports, defect resolution records.
